_comment_age: Optional (int or float, e.g. 8 or 1.5). If omitted, only the age-independent checks (dedicated space, routine, device-free bedroom/mealtime) run -- the age-banded screen-time/sleep advisories below are skipped rather than guessed.

study_space.location: <e.g. desk in own room, corner of living room, dining table>
distraction_controls: <e.g. phone stored outside the room during study time, TV off, siblings' play area separate>

routine.study_schedule: <e.g. Mon-Fri 19:00-20:30, after dinner, before free time>
routine._comment_times: bedtime/wake_time optional, 24h HH:MM. Used only for the National-Sleep-Foundation-range advisory below.
